meta.description: Opens and closes a cap: every ray bends down along its length until its margin meets the stipe. Connect time to watch a button open, or an age to open old caps further than young ones. Put it after margin_waves and margin_curl, so the closed margin still meets the stipe. Join the caps that share a stipe (flesh and ridges) into one cap_open: the one that reaches furthest closes until it meets the stipe, the others close with it and stay under it. Gives the margin of the posed cap as points.

cap.description: The rays of a cap, or of several caps on the same stipes

hinge.description: The hinge of the cap node: where the cap sits and how thick the stipe is

opening.description: 0 = a closed button with the margin against the stipe, 1 = open as the cap was drawn
